title: Domestic Electrician | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Domestic Electrician. Category: Vocational Training Courses. Duration: 4 months. Description: Domestic wiring and installation, safety tools and protection systems, single-phase wiring, MCBs, main switches, circuit breakers, and installation of switches, sockets, fans, and lights, plus fault finding and troubleshooting. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
